_note: Registry of the Claude connectors (MCP tools) reachable from the founder's Claude Code sessions. They are NOT callable by the headless factory loop: only a Claude session (the factory doctor) can use them, and results enter the factory through scripts/connector_intake.py. `state` is what a live read-only probe showed on `probed_on`; `UNPROBED` means not tested, never assumed. Permission classes: READ_INTAKE (read, record in the intake ledger), PERSONAL_WRITE (changes the founder's own workspace: needs explicit approval per action), OUTBOUND (reaches third parties: never without explicit approval of recipient and text), FINANCIAL (reads money data: only aggregate counts, only when a sale is expected).

metricool.factory_use: Pinterest pin analytics (impressions, saves, pin clicks, outbound clicks) and TikTok/Pinterest account facts; the only measured exposure signal for the pins
metricool.never: publish or schedule posts through it (free plan cannot; pins go out from Pinterest's own builder with explicit batch approval)

gmail.factory_use: independent check of sales: Gumroad sale notification emails (a sale is real when the email and the API agree); buyer replies to outreach
gmail.consumer: connector_intake (counts only) -> demand_gate BUYER_INTEREST via the interest ledger when a real non-test inquiry exists
gmail.never: send, draft, label or delete mail; read personal mail: searches are limited to factory senders and counted, bodies are not stored

google_calendar.factory_use: reminders for founder-only steps (prospect calls, reviews) if the founder asks
google_calendar.never: create or edit events without the founder's explicit yes per event

hubspot.scopes: read contacts, companies, deals, tickets; write needs re-authorization
hubspot.factory_use: optional prospect tracker for the Umrah-agency outreach (the manual table in OUTREACH_MESSAGES.md could live here)
hubspot.never: create records or send email without explicit approval

linear.factory_use: task board for founder-only blockers if the founder wants one

notion.factory_use: none required: the factory's own docs are the record

bird.factory_use: email/SMS/WhatsApp platform: could deliver outreach once the founder approves recipients and text; read-only scopes today
bird.never: send anything: contacting real people is the founder's act (red line)

paypal.factory_use: independent confirmation that a Gumroad payout arrived (FIRST_REAL_DOLLAR), aggregate count only, once a sale exists
paypal.never: read transaction details beyond counts and payer names that are the platform's own

n8n_connector.factory_use: the factory already reaches its local n8n directly

canva.factory_use: optional pin/cover design; the factory has its own cover designer

zapier.factory_use: none planned (a second automation layer would duplicate the loop)
